details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3409 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The iteration label always resolves to `unknown` because the step reads env vars that are never exported.
  WHY: The iteration value is captured as a step output, not as an environment variable, so shell expansion in this step cannot see the real count.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:303-330 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The placeholder-removal filter depends on exact literal text and dash characters, so a producer-side wording change can leak placeholder lines into the scope file.
  WHY: Both reports describe hard-coded exclusion of specific placeholder strings, which is fragile under format drift.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:305-332 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Splitting field 4 on `:` can truncate or drop scoped paths when the ledger entry format is malformed or a path contains a colon.
  WHY: All three reports point at the same parser assumption: the code treats column 4 as `FILE:LINES` and loses information if that delimiter is not safe.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3457-3462 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_count_lines` counts non-empty lines instead of validating `ledger_status.txt` rows against the expected tab-delimited schema.
  WHY: The rest of the parser treats `ledger_status.txt` as structured data, so malformed or non-data lines can inflate the total.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3461-3466 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Parser stats values are emitted without trimming, so trailing whitespace can leak into the summary table.
  WHY: Other helpers normalize their outputs, but `_stat_value` does not, making its cells susceptible to formatting noise.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3473 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The override-count fallback relies on a fragile `grep -c ... || echo 0` pattern that only works because later string trimming happens to mask it.
  WHY: The file itself documents this exact pattern as something to avoid, so the count is brittle if the later cleanup changes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3476-3478 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `editor_committed` can be reported as yes from stale `COMMITTED_FILES_FILE` contents.
  WHY: The metric keys off file presence/non-emptiness, so it depends on upstream cleanup that is not verified here.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3439-3515 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The metrics step rescans `ledger_status.txt` multiple times to compute per-state counts.
  WHY: Those counters could be gathered in one pass, so the current implementation does extra work on every iteration.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3420-3425 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Malformed `key=value` lines in parser stats collapse to zero without any signal.
  WHY: The awk fallback treats missing or broken assignments as empty and the summary reports 0, which hides bad input.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3495-3498 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `scope_mode` metric can fall back to `full-diff` when the runtime directory is unavailable, even though that is just a missing-path condition.
  WHY: The check is keyed off `${RUNTIME_DIR}/reviewer_iteration_scope.txt`, so an absent runtime directory silently drives the fallback.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:317-318 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Sorting the scoped-file list can fail silently, leaving the scope block empty without any diagnostic.
  WHY: The command is wrapped in `|| true`, so filesystem or disk failures are swallowed and the prompt falls back unexpectedly.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:278-375 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer scope block is inserted into the prompt before the injection guard, so workflow-produced text can appear outside the guard fence.
  WHY: The block is built from files that are not validated as plain filenames before interpolation.
- README.md:~977 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The prose description omits `REVIEW_FLOOR_RULES_ENABLED` even though the env-var table documents it.
  WHY: Operators reading only the narrative section will not discover that kill switch.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3444-3450 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The override-count grep is anchored to the start of the line, so any future prefix before `CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN:` makes the count drop to zero.
  WHY: The current pattern only matches a bare marker at column 0, which is brittle if the editor summary format changes.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
